name: Super Claude For Sap
description:
ABAP Class Creation & Unit Testing
Debugging & Root Cause Analysis
SPRO Configuration Reference
Cross-Module Integration Analysis
longDescription:
Ships **17 skills**, **26 agents**, **11 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (17): `analyze-cbo-obj` (Analyze a CBO (Customer Business Object) package — discover frequently-used Z tables / function modules / data elements…), `analyze-code` (ABAP code analysis — delegate source reads + AST/semantic/where-used analysis + rule-based review to sap-code-reviewer, then optionally render…), `analyze-symptom` (Step-by-step root cause analysis for SAP operational errors), `ask-consultant` (Direct operational Q&A with a SAP module consultant agent), `compare-programs` (Business-angle comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs that share the same business scenario but diverge by module (MM vs…), `create-object` (ABAP object creation workflow — confirm transport+package, auto-create and activate), `create-program` (Create ABAP programs (Report/CRUD/ALV/Batch) with Main+Include structure, OOP or Procedural, and full agent-driven coding/QA pipeline), `deep-interview` (Socratic deep interview to crystallize SAP requirements before autonomous execution), and 9 more
- **Agents** (26): `sap-analyst` (SAP requirements analysis — functional specifications, gap analysis, and acceptance criteria (Opus, R/O)), `sap-architect` (SAP system architecture — technical design, ABAP architecture, and integration patterns (Opus, R/O)), `sap-ariba-consultant` (SAP Ariba consultant — procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract management, Ariba Network), `sap-bc-consultant` (SAP Basis administration — system monitoring, transport management, performance tuning, dump analysis (Opus, R/O)), `sap-bw-consultant` (SAP Business Warehouse consultant — data modeling, ETL, BEx queries, HANA-optimized InfoProviders, BW/4HANA), `sap-co-consultant` (SAP Controlling consultant — cost center accounting, internal orders, product costing, profitability analysis), `sap-code-reviewer` (ABAP code review — Clean ABAP, performance, security, SAP standard compliance (Opus, R/O)), `sap-critic` (SAP quality gate — functional specification review, configuration validation, and implementation plan critique (Opus, R/O)), and 18 more
- **Hooks** (11): `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, and 3 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `sap`

Installs with `claude plugin install super-claude-for-sap@claude-community` from `babamba2/superclaude-for-sap`.
